name: saronite-host-app
description: The Metro/JS entry point that actually runs Saronite mini-apps inside itunda's native Android app. Registers one AppRegistry component per mini-app in mini-apps/*; each mini-app gets its own concrete Activity subclass hardcoding which component to render (see android/app/.../miniapps/MiniAppActivity.kt) -- not an Intent-extra dispatch, which was tried and reverted after a real crash (ReactActivity builds its delegate in <init>, before Android attaches the launch Intent).
